newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia OTC stock market dips in week to May 16.
newsitem.headline: Croatia OTC stock market dips in week to May 16.

text.p: Croatia's over-the-counter (OTC) market dipped in the week to May 16 following similar developments on the central bourse, the Varazdin Securities Market reported on Monday.
Volume was halved at 6,736 units with turnover also much lower at 2.4 million kuna, after trade slowed considerably.
The seven-stock VIN index sank 1.22 percent on a weekly basis to 9,912 points. Overall 13 active issues fell, seven rose and 10 were unchanged.
Shipyard Brodospas led decliners, losing 21.11 percent to end at 71 kuna on volume of 100 shares.
Bjelovarska Banka, which added 48.04 percent to 4,900 kuna, was the biggest gainer but traded only 15 shares.
Podravka was again the most active stock with 1,118 units sold, though its volume also shrank from a week earlier. It closed 6.08 percent lower at 278 kuna.
